notes.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 developer is trying to figure out who put the edgy Guitar Hero gag in the game it made, promises to remove it in the next update even though players want it to stay

It also committed to removing the image in question, even though players are now asking the studio to just leave it alone... Read more.

notes.title: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 (PS5) Review
notes.content:
The remasters of the first two games to bear the Hawkman’s name came as a breath of nostalgic fresh air back in 2021, recapturing the essence of an era. Now, Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 gives the same treatment to the next two games in the franchise, but much like their original versions on PlayStation 2, they feel a little less… essential.

Iron Galaxy Studios has taken the torch from Vicarious Visions to remaster the back half of Neversoft’s genre-defining franchise (and we’ll all keep pretending the fifth game didn’t happen). This project almost didn’t see the light of day when Vicarious became a casualty of the Activision-Blizzard acquisition. Still, Iron Galaxy stepped in to see it through, having assisted with the excellent Metroid Prime Remastered. They’ve largely lived up to the presentational standard of THPS1+2.

Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 merges the two “campaigns” into a shared hub menu, where you can also outfit... Read more

Not sure what game or accessibility settings work for you? Test them out in tutorial mode before making it official.[/p][h2][u]Craft Your Perfect Skate[/u][/h2][p] [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/acad162c5dc0a6e60dec5a04e435a682da9bfaff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Some players like the intense challenge of landing hard tricks and combos while others just want to have a good time or might struggle with the fine motor skills necessary to keep their skater balanced on the skateboard. Whatever your preference, a host of Game Mods is included to help tailor your experience for the perfect skate.[/p][p] [/p][p]Game Mod settings* include a toggle for Perfect Rail Balance, Perfect Manual Balance, Perfect Lip Balance, Perfect Skitch Balance, No Bails, and Instant Quick Recovery. Each setting can be individually toggled on or off, allowing you to zero in on exactly the setup that works for you.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Score, Timer, and Game Speed Adjustments[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/8fa70250cccd3928c848fb782c07d632c422e6f6.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]If landing a Sick Score or any other tough goal within the game’s default two-minute timer seems like an impossible task, consider these features to help close the gap toward achieving each park’s goals.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Double Base Score: [/b]Stuck on a tough park? notes.title: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4: Ramp up to Launch
notes.content:
The shred’s not dead, and it’s time to prove it. Dust off your trucks and get ready for [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i], launching July 11 on PC. Play it on day one with Game Pass.

Developed by Iron Galaxy Studios, [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4[/i] brings remakes of all the original parks plus new ones like Waterpark, Pinball, and Movie Studio. A stacked roster of new and returning skaters represent a killer lineup, including OG legends like Tony Hawk and Bob Burnquist and a new generation of skaters from Rayssa Leal to Yuto Horigome.

With a robust Career Mode, cross-platform multiplayer*, enhanced creation tools, New Game+, and more, you can bet on an endless roll of epic skate sessions. Now let’s take a look at some of the highlights awaiting you:
[h2][u]Two New Park Reveals: Pinball, Movie Studio[/u][/h2]
Skate across remakes of all the original parks plus three new ones: Waterpark, Pinball, and Movie Studio. Following our [url=https://www.tonyhawkthegame.com/blog/2025/03/tony-hawk-pro-skater-three-plus-four-launch-map-guide-waterpark]Waterpark reveal[/url] in March, here’s a closer look at Pinball and Movie Studio.
[h3]Pinball[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/47123f9c686b8ab2b4a8881991a24a13ebbb8e90.jpg[/img]

Drop into the Skate of the Living Dead pinball machine during an active game being played by none other than Tony Hawk himself. Watch out for the silver pinball flying over the board as the birdman aims for a high score.

Catch air off pop bumpers, grind the network of wire rails positioned above the playfield, and watch for chomping alligators down the dangerous river. You can always skate into the scoop to transport to the mausoleum above, setting up the perfect run to light up the backbox display with your sickest combo.

For a closer look, check out our [url=https://www.tonyhawkthegame.com/blog/2025/06/tony-hawk-pro-skater-three-four-park-map-guide-pinball]Pinball park preview[/url].
[h3]Movie Studio[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/4364321647bc7c0658664fedb1864090a16ed414.jpg[/img]

Make your cinematic debut in Movie Studio, a new competition park set in and around Stage 34. Skate around green screens near sci fi props like a beaming spaceship and the tentacles of a cosmic creature. The track running through Stage 34 and Avenue C provides a consistent floor grind with access to further rails and ramps near the crash site and by the digital ramp displaying an alien landscape.

Perfect your runs in Free Skate to help up your score when competing here in the Career Tour. In competitions, each participant skates three one-minute heats, the sum of your best two heats representing your final score. Land in the top three to finish with a medal.

Prepare for the epic scenes ahead by studying up on our [url=https://www.tonyhawkthegame.com/blog/2025/06/tony-hawk-pro-skater-three-four-park-map-guide-movie-studio]Movie Studio park[/url] preview.
[h2][u]Skater Reveals: Michelangelo, Bam Margera[/u][/h2][h3]Michelangelo[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/5bd3029110954603ac87e6ca492dd0ddd72b7470.jpg[/img]

Always ready to join the party, TMNT’s Michelangelo escapes Splinter’s prying eyes in a trip out of the sewers. Shred in the name of the [i]Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles[/i] and show these humans how it’s done. Cowabunga!
[h3]Bam Margera[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/0dd679c8cac0c4489744bff90be8c6dcddf691c7.jpg[/img]

Hailing from West Chester, Pennsylvania, former pro skateboarder, stunt performer, television personality, and filmmaker Bam Margera was first revealed at [url=https://www.tonyhawkthegame.com/blog/2025/05/tony-hawk-pro-skater-three-four-thps-fest-los-angeles]THPS Fest[/url], a fan of the game and featured skater in multiple titles. There’s no ramp or grind too gnarly for Bam, making him the perfect skater for pulling off the most daring tricks.
[h2][u]Keep Shredding in New Game+[/u][/h2]
Take everything you’ve learned and push it to the next level in New Game+! Retain the stats you earned in your first playthrough while tackling legacy goals from classic games and new objectives like Pro Goals and Expert Challenges.

Pro Goals added to every park include striving for the Platinum Score, executing complex environmental tricks, and collecting C-O-M-B-O, a challenge similar to S-K-A-T-E with the requirement that you collect all the letters in one fell swoop. Plus, take on Expert Challenges, testing your skate mastery with speedruns, score challenges, gap combos, and more.

[b]Solo Tours: [/b]Take what you’ve learned into Solo Tours. Replay the Career as each skater on the roster. The challenge has never been greater, as you’ll have to complete all base and Pro Goals in each level, with more cash, new tricks, and new S-K-A-T-E letter placements depending on your skater’s style to keep things fresh.
[h2][u]Multiplayer: Cross-Platform, Private, Local[/u][/h2]
Trade tricks and compete for glory in cross-platform online multiplayer supporting up to eight skaters at once across a variety of game modes including the new HAWK mode. Search for public lobbies or keep it to just your friends with Private Match support. And when the competition’s personal, compete shoulder to shoulder in Local Multiplayer supporting split screen play.
[h3]Play the new HAWK Mode[/h3]
It’s skateboarding Hide and Seek! During the hide phase, participants skate the chosen map, dropping the individual letters spelling H-A-W-K along the way. Drop the H along a hard-to-reach grind, the A at the apex of a sky-high aerial… use your park knowledge and get creative in placing the four letters.

In the seeking phase, each skater must collect their opponent’s letters before the timer runs out. Earn bonus points if any of your letters remain. The highest score after three rounds wins.

[b]And the Classics: [/b]Chill in Multiplayer Free Skate and compete in returning favorites including the modes listed below, with additional local multiplayer support for Horse and Tag. Adjust time and score limits, choose the park, and shred.

[b]Trick Attack: [/b]Highest score at the end of a set time limit. 

[b]Score Challenge: [/b]First to hit the target score wins. 

[b]Combo Mambo: [/b]Nail the biggest combo before time runs out. 

[b]Combo Challenge: [/b]First to land the target combo score. 

[b]Graffiti: [/b]Land tricks to tag the most objects on the map. 
[h3]Quality of Life Features[/h3]
[b]Voice Chat: [/b]Toggle Voice Chat on or off with a Push to Talk feature for comms at the press of a button. Choose between the All Lobby and Party Only voice channels and set the voice chat level to your preferred volume.

[b]Streamer Mode: [/b]Skip music tracks not suitable for content creation, replaced with a variety of original tracks that can be added to the overall playlist even after leaving Streamer Mode.
[h2][u]Create-A-Park[/u][/h2]
Make your dream park and share it with other skaters in Create-A-Park, a skating sandbox giving you the tools to get creative with dozens of objects and obstacles including dynamic content and custom goals that bring your park to life. Share your creations and play and rate other players’ parks. Skate community favorites in the featured section and share parks across platforms.

A series of helpful tips including video demonstrations make the building and editing process an easy one to pick up even for newcomers.
[h3]Custom Goals[/h3]
Give visitors to your new park a challenge using custom goals that merge seamlessly into the environment. Place the letters spelling out S-K-A-T-E, set High Score and Smash goals, look for the perfect nook to stow away the Secret Tape, and more.
[h3]New Gameplay Objects[/h3]
Choose from a ton of skateable pieces to place and snap together. Place quarter pipes, ramps, fun boxes, pools, floors, rails, decorations, props, and landmarks, each category featuring up to a dozen or more options creating a near limitless variety of park designs. Lay down an airplane, a pagoda, or a fountain made for grinding. Incorporate dynamic props that can be knocked around the map, and more. If you can skate it, there’s a way to make it.

notes.title: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4: Returning skaters
notes.content:
The roster of skaters originally featured in [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 [/i]and[i] Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 4[/i] helped to further catapult skateboarding culture into the mainstream as big names like Bob Burnquist, Steve Caballero, Elissa Steamer, and Chad Muska joined Tony Hawk in a stacked roster of award-winning pro skaters capable of shredding in and out of the game.

In this feature, following the Demo announcement and the full [url=https://www.tonyhawkthegame.com/blog/2025/06/tony-hawk-pro-skater-three-four-full-soundtrack]soundtrack reveal[/url], we’re proud to share the full roster of returning skaters in the upcoming [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i] arriving on PC.

[i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater[/i][i] 3 + 4[/i] launches on July 11.
[h2][u]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4: Returning Skaters[/u][/h2]
From gold medalists to progenitors of some of today’s most iconic skateboarding tricks, these classic skaters were instrumental in bringing skateboarding culture to a wider audience. Mixing courage, creativity, and an iron will, they’re more than ready to tackle any obstacle put before them.

“Being in the original games was epic!” shares Elissa Steamer, who was the first playable female skater in the original [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater[/i] game. “It was semi-life changing. I can’t say enough about how stoked I was – and am now! [u]–[/u] to be in the games.”

“From the moment Tony asked, it was an honor, yet I had no idea of what it would come to mean,” says Rodney Mullen, originator of the kickflip and largely considered one of the most influential skaters in the sport. “The first time I showed up on tour after the release of the game, I recall ‘em shop owners having to put me on top of the tour van roof to manage so that I could sign things in all the madness. The crowd was rocking the van back and forth! [It] blew my mind, the impact it had.”

“The game attracted such a broader group of skaters, which has elevated our community in layered ways: from tricks to societal acceptance to the respect we get from people who often thought otherwise, like parents discouraging their kids who were simply outsiders looking for a place to belong,” Mullen continues. “Skating is integrated with a culture, a way of being, more than pretty much any other sport I can think of. The way Tony’s game shows that via the music, art, and vibe batted this home. It’s cool to be understood.”

When[i] Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater[/i][i] 3 + [/i]4 launches this July, here are the returning skaters ready to hit the pavement once again, including skaters featured in the original [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3[/i] and [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 4[/i] games plus other titles in the series.

notes.title: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 Park Guide: Pinball
notes.content:
Hit up the arcade and shred high combos on Pinball, one of several new parks joining the lineup of original parks in the upcoming [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i], launching July 11 on PC.

Pinball drops players into a pinball game featuring the tombstones of fallen skaters around a playfield filled with ramps, rails, and flippers at the control of Tony Hawk. Watch out for silver balls running down the board and track your best combo on the backbox display.

Developer Iron Galaxy Studios shares a special connection to pinball, many of its early members incorporating their knowledge acquired while working for Midway Games in Chicago, a prominent name in arcade and pinball gaming. This homage offers the perfect mix honoring their roots while flexing their creative skills in a wild new park design.

Check out Pinball early with this bird’s eye view examining the main points of interest in the park followed by tips to up your score on the board.
[h3]Bird’s Eye View: Pinball[/h3]
Drop in and blast out high scores across the following points of interest around the park:
[h2][/h2][h2]The Eyeball[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/302e201ac5fe86cb2a80e9ab807c690bef546211.jpg[/img]

As if in direct challenge, a large eye between the slingshots tracks the playfield above. Grind along the flippers and catch some air off the yellow ramps lining the area, including a sick jump right over the zombie’s mouth at the front of the machine. Catch the short railings on the rollovers here to boost your current combo multiplier and plan your next target up the board.

To reset your starting position, turn back and ride into the zombie’s mouth. Don’t worry, you won’t get eaten; it prefers to spit you back out over the top of the plunger where you first dropped into the park.
[h2]Skate[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/5d39a34dca6b45c6103a6d774ad86314f71e7c34.jpg[/img]

The left side of the playfield spells out SKATE through the middle, squeezed between the bird’s mouth and the center ramp giving access to the upper level. A ground ramp facing toward the front of the playfield offers the chance to get air when coming in from the back of the board, with grindable objects on either side.

For a quick journey to the back of the playfield, ride through the bird’s mouth, activating Multiball and teleporting your skater to the platform outside the mausoleum in the back left corner.

Brains

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/3789e17fb941e7b8b061e52b7a1f3d5726113b4c.jpg[/img]

Sail past the SKATE floor to reach the brains section of the playfield, combining an assortment of grind rails and small to massive ramps including a trio of pop bumpers offering 360-degree air support.

Enter the scoop — the opening in the brick wall through the broken bars — for a quick trip up to the mausoleum above, giving access to the wire rail snaking over the playfield and a run of spinners that leads to a gnarly jump over the rooftops. If you’d rather take your chances on the other side of the board, skate up and over the green slime by the center bridge to move through the opening and out to the river.
[h2]Film Alley[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/fd36f37a239af14c303bb8e956d078234d5481f1.jpg[/img]

Kick up your board and enjoy a horror movie playing on the big screen over the right side of the playfield. A yellow grind rail follows a twist in the road, while the adjacent curb also caters to a long grind. The center ramp leads to shut bars for now, though you can grind up its ledges to get up high if you’ve got the speed to push all the way up.

Against the wall, a tunnel gives open access to the other side. The best way of getting on its roof is from the top of the plunger, its boost pad easily vaulting you over the top splitting two ways toward the river, one of which features a second boost pad to keep the momentum going.
[h2]The River[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/1f892cf1162b1d87632096e69ac5b7fcac9a8646.jpg[/img]

Watch for hungry alligators chomping along the riverbed on the right side of the playfield. Grind over the backs of snakes and launch off the corner boost pad for huge air up the ramp running along the back wall. If you stick to the right wall starting from the plunger, you’ll hit three boost pads along the whole path for a massive run of speed.

Hit a fourth boost pad by skating into the open log after turning around on the back ramp. Hit the center grind rail as you travel under the water, then pop back out right back into film alley.
[h1]Pro Tips[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/e0a083e640ae46d20574d5c1dd53cb11f14dea77.jpg[/img]

[b]1. Watch that ball[/b][b]![/b] There’s a live game going on here, with none other than Tony Hawk in control of the flippers. Keep your eyes open for the silver pinball as it careens and rebounds around the playfield. The ball moves at a medium pace, giving you time to get out of the way, but fail to move and it’ll knock you over.

[b]2. Beat your high score. [/b]A tracker on the backbox displays the highest point combo yet achieved in the run, lit up in bright green numbers for easy reading. Use it as motivation to beat your own score, pulling off intricate combos and special tricks to boost that number higher.

[b]3. Highwire transport. [/b]The wire rails running over the playfield are perfect for long grinds and for getting across the board quickly without the need to skate around obstacles on the ground. Check your balance, build up a long grind combo, and get where you need to go fast.

[b]4. Pinball highway. [/b]While you’re up on the wire rails, note the system of ramps and obstacles along the walls that extend the play space above the board. Incorporate both levels into your session to maximize combo opportunities.

[b]5. Explore the board. [/b]Pinball is an intricate game with all kinds of hidden interactions meant to be discovered during play. The same goes for this park themed after the classic pastime; explore every ramp, rail, and hidden entrance to unlock the board’s full capabilities.

notes.title: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4: THPS Fest at El Rey Theatre
notes.content:
[i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i] is quickly nearing its July 11 release date, and to celebrate the upcoming launch, skaters, musicians, developers, and press were invited to the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles for THPS Fest, an evening of gaming, deep dives with skaters in the game, and performances by four of the artists featured on the [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4[/i] in-game soundtrack.

In partnership with concert promoter Goldenvoice, THPS Fest was hosted by sports commentator Selema Masekela, skateboard host and former Activision capture artist Steezus, and in-game skater Nora Vasconcellos. It also saw appearances from both returning and new skate talents like Chloe Covell, Steve Caballero, Jamie Foy, Kareem Campbell, Geoff Rowley, Margielyn Didal, Nora Vasconcellos, Tony Hawk, and more.

Read on for a breakdown of the event and game content, including a look at the featured skateparks, innovations and enhancements, the reveal of two skaters, and more being brought into the game by the developers at Iron Galaxy Studios.

Iron Galaxy Studios has a long history of working on some of the top IPs in video games. Their meticulous attention to detail and quality creates unforgettable gameplay experienced by players around the world. And now they’re extremely excited to put their stamp on [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4[/i].
[h2][u]Soundtrack to Skating[/u][/h2]
THPS Fest attendees were treated to unforgettable live performances from four featured artists from the [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4[/i] in-game soundtrack which included Urethane, Adolescents, Danny Brown, and Lupe Fiasco.

The final of the [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4[/i] soundtrack was recently revealed with complete details of nearly every artist and track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/d45651efe2c0af55cc014d6877a3aad65f7daf60.jpg[/img]
[h2][u]Secret Skaters[/u][/h2]
The Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater games are infamous for their wild cast of secret skaters, and [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4[/i] is no different. Meet two of the highly anticipated secret skaters, who were announced during THPS Fest.

[b]Andy Anderson: [/b]Canadian skateboarder and helmet safety advocate known for his creative approach to blending street, vert, and freestyle skating into one delightful package.

[b]Bam Margera: [/b]American former pro skateboarder, stunt performer, television personality, filmmaker, and a featured skater from the original [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3[/i].
[h2][u]El Rey Event: The Parks[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/393b49ca8cecf27ec0cd7947bef4931b92399fb9.jpg[/img]

Attendees got their hands on nine skateparks from the game, featuring five from the [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3[/i] Skate Tour and four from the [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 4[/i] Skate Tour, including the new Waterpark level.
[h3]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 Skate Tour Parks[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/44e0d0f5f40c02750bf89dc0e619edd10152850d.jpg[/img]

[b]Los Angeles: [/b]Hit up sick tricks in the urban landscape of L.A. underneath the Hollywood sign. Watch out for traffic, check out upcoming movies advertised on a vert ramp outside the El Rey theater, and set an earthquake into motion.

[b]Foundry:[/b] The first skatepark players will drop into as part of the [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3[/i] Skate Tour, Foundry is set in an industrial steel mill with molten metal, ramps, grind rails, a secret area, and explosive environmental hazards.

[b]Canada:[/b] Shred in Calgary, Alberta at a snowy outdoor skatepark with ramps, rails, and cabins in an area blending urban and natural elements for diverse trick opportunities.

[b]Rio:[/b] A vibrant competition level set in Brazil featuring a colorful stadium in downtown Rio with high-scoring lines designed for intense contest runs.

[b]Suburbia:[/b] Drop into a neighborhood cul-de-sac during Halloween and skate in a construction zone, a haunted house, and a backward swimming pool. Just try not to get run over by the ice cream truck.
[h3]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 4 Skate Tour Parks[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/dffe39d9e09700c29d8cf9fcdc59d2c364aa9be6.jpg[/img]

[b]College:[/b] Skip class and shred the sprawling CCHU campus, stopping in to pop off tricks over the rooftops and across the student plaza while building up huge combos over the stadium rails. Go Chicken Hawks!

[b]San Francisco: [/b]Skate outside the Boardwalk View Hotel with views of the San Francisco Bay. Skitch a ride on the trolley, go sightseeing at The Pier, and grind along the overhead walkway in this park blending street skating with vert elements across a large, explorable cityscape.

[b]Alcatraz: [/b]Visit the gritty island prison and skate its rooftop and the surrounding grounds including a line up to the lighthouse and some sick vert action inside the compound in view of the jail cells.

[b]Waterpark: [/b]A new park being added to the [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 4[/i] Skate Tour, Waterpark takes place in the Mojave Desert at a water theme park with rides you can combo on and a skateable lazy river. Get a deeper dive on the new skatepark with our Bird’s Eye View feature found [url=https://www.tonyhawkthegame.com/blog/2025/03/tony-hawk-pro-skater-three-plus-four-launch-map-guide-waterpark]here[/url].
[h2][u]Shout Out to our Sponsors[/u][/h2]
A huge thanks to our Sponsors who helped at the event, including [b]Taco Bell[/b], for keeping attendees fed with the Taco Bell Live Mas truck. Don’t miss the Taco Bell Cantina storefront in the Los Angeles, College, and Airport levels along with Taco Bell skate decks, grip tape, and apparel.

[b]Skullcandy[/b] provided 40 PLYR® Wireless headphones to the media, an upcoming headphones model that attendees could try for the first time at the event’s gaming stations.

We’d also like to thank [b]Depop [/b]for creating one of the most electric corners in the theater featuring live tagging on a graffiti wall in the Depop Print Shop.

[b]Red Bull[/b] supported the event as the official drink sponsor; look out for their branding in the Canada level along with extra Create-A-Skater items and six Red Bull pro skaters: Chloe Covell, Jamie Foy, Zion Wright, Yuto Horigome, Margielyn Didal, and Leticia Bufoni.

Meanwhile, [b]Kellogg’s[/b] offered 500 cereal boxes for on-site guests plus accompanied by a special appearance by Tony the Tiger.

notes.title: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 launches July 11
notes.content:
Get hyped for the legendary return of the birdman himself in the next-gen remake of [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i], arriving on PC.

Shred the original parks with the classic roster of skaters joined by new parks, skaters, and tricks in a remake of THPS 3 + 4, featuring Career mode, cross-platform multiplayer, enhanced creation tools, New Game+, and more. Alert the neighborhood and grab your skate buddies because the shred’s not dead. It’s back and better than ever.

[previewyoutube=5f-3HBoojQE;full][/previewyoutube]

THPS 3 + 4 drops on July 11. Here’s what’s coming down the halfpipe:
[h2][u]Drop Back into the Skating Action[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/64ea716a3a948df8e7e1cc7432d653329e0afd34.jpg[/img]

Everything you love is back and rebuilt from the ground up with new skaters and parks, extra tricks, and new tracks to crank up. Skate through a robust Career mode taking on challenges across two tours, chase high scores in Single Sessions and Speedruns, or chill out and dig into the map in Free Skate.

Cross-platform online multiplayer supports up to eight skaters at a time. Go head-to-head or take your time and skate every surface in the multiplayer Free Skate. Whether you’re a casual skater or a grungy pro, the smooth handling and simple-to-learn controls from [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 1 [/i]+ [i]2[/i] are back in THPS 3 + 4, so you’ll be ready to go no matter the mode.
[h3]Classic and New Parks[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/d4404b835066c04034a7e859749f1d609fc2ac0e.jpg[/img]

The parks from THPS3 and THPS4 have been authentically remade in jaw dropping 4K resolution* with streamlined goals in a two minute format. Plus, tear it up in new parks including Waterpark with its grindable slides and a drained out lazy river that’s perfect for vert trick combos.

Tackle a robust set of challenges to earn in-game cash and access to new gear including new decks, grip tapes, and wheels for your board and extra apparel for your skater.

[b]New Game+[/b]

Shred harder than ever in New Game+! Retain the stats you earned in your first playthrough and perfect your skills across every park in the game.
[h3]New Skaters, Tricks, Songs[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/390f2abb1a83f5271ab38bd026b4483a24e1b43b.jpg[/img]

THPS 3 + 4 brings the perfect mix of classic and new, adding new skaters to the lineup and new tricks to discover. Create your own skater with in-depth customization options for hair, tattoos, makeup, and more. Pick your skater’s name, hometown, and skating style and start making a name for yourself!

An in-game tutorial led by Tony Hawk himself will get you off to a good start with lessons on the all-important Ollie, kick flips, vert tricks, grinds, reverts, manuals, special tricks and everything you need to become a high score skater, all while rocking out to songs from the original soundtrack and new music.
[h2][u]Skate in the Foundry Demo[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/f07e8dc666cd54f7494bf57f2ea8d6f2621aac9d.jpg[/img]

Pre-purchase THPS 3 + 4 on select platforms** to skate in the Foundry Demo in June including two playable skaters, two parks, and a selection of songs. Players who pre-purchase the game will gain instant access to the in-game Wireframe Tony Shader at launch, giving a wild new look to the legendary skater.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/c81c5d617fffd3d1d0ba7738c30ec29de47fd033.jpg[/img]
[h2][u]Digital Deluxe Edition: Early Access, Doom Slayer and More[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/8d9a5a1a9d2f29f43e864a97c02cfc5f068cd7a8.png[/img]

Pre-purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition and gain Early Access*** to play Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 three days before the official July 11 launch date.
[h3]Skate as Doom Slayer, Revenant[/h3]
Blast onto the scene with the Doom Slayer and Revenant skaters and get extra music, skate decks, and Create-A-Skater gear:
[list]	[*][b]Doom Slayer: [/b]Play as Doom Slayer, featuring a Standard and Retro outfit plus two unique special tricks and the Unmaykr Hoverboard.[/*]	[*][b]Revenant:[/b] Get evil with the Revenant, including two unique special tricks.[/*]	[*][b]Additional Music:[/b] Headbang to a selection of classic and modern music tracks added to the in-game soundtrack.[/*]	[*][b]Skate Decks: [/b]Access additional skate decks including Doom Slayer and Revenant themed designs.[/*]	[*][b]Create-A-Skater Items: [/b]Kit out your skater with additional apparel items, including a baseball cap, two sweatshirts, and two t-shirts.[/*][/list][h2][u]Collector’s Edition: For the Ultimate Skaters[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526327/23deb4561c726bec8f73d0218020becb1f627a26.png[/img]

Skate in and out of the game with the Collector’s Edition to receive a limited-edition full-size Birdhouse® skateboard deck**** featuring a reissued version of the iconic [i]Wings [/i]graphic and a printed Tony Hawk autograph. The Collector’s Edition includes a physical copy of the game with a voucher for all the Digital Deluxe Edition benefits.
